tasks.instruction: Annotate V2, final verbs, negation, and discourse function.
items: Kan u asseblief die adres ’n bietjie stadiger herhaal?
Saterdag het ons die museum besoek en daarna middagete geëet.
key: Afrikaans combines verb-second main clauses with verb-final subordinate clauses, largely invariant present verbs, het plus participle past, modal chains, separable verbs and clause-bounding double negation. Spelling, register, information structure and community variation shape accurate use.
